QUOTE: "`skipSync: true` | add path | `sanitizeReactions` returns before computing `deleteReactions`. The `!skipSync` guard in `handleReactions` also blocks the delete branch. Without this, the single-reaction payload would look like a full snapshot and delete every other reaction on the post."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that without skipSync the single-reaction payload would be treated as a full snapshot and delete all other reactions on the post.
